purpose: Independent PixOffice 2.5D collaborative office visual prototype
reference: User-supplied office design reference; existing products and formal character packs are not modified.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: background plate for a modular interactive 2.5D office, NOT a UI screenshot.
Reference image role: style, materials, light and warmth reference only.
Create a beautiful sunlit miniature contemporary office interior with the same polished high-quality 3D-rendered chibi-world feel as the reference. Landscape 1536x1024. Fixed orthographic camera, yaw 45 degrees, elevation about 30 degrees, verticals vertical, ground axes at consistent +/-26.565 degree slopes (2:1 dimetric). Full-frame interior, not a floating dollhouse on a white backdrop.
Back left: very large windows with distant city and soft blue sky, warm oak low shelves with books, a few leafy plants. Back right: cream walls and oak bookshelves, neatly grouped binders, small potted plants, a clock. Background architecture and storage occupy ONLY the upper 35 percent and narrow outer edges. The lower 65 percent is a LARGE CLEAR uninterrupted light gray/off-white tiled floor for separately composited desks and people. Natural daylight from upper left, soft realistic shadows, warm oak contrasted with pale gray and green plants, crisp pleasant details.
Critical: absolutely NO people, NO robot, NO workstations, NO desks, NO chairs, NO whiteboard, NO UI, NO cards, NO overlay, NO text or lettering, NO logos. Preserve generous clear floor, do not put plants or furniture in its center. Nothing cropped awkwardly on the floor. This is the empty room background; other independent sprite assets will be added later.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent sprite sheet of 6 independent workstation cutouts for a 2.5D interactive office.
Reference image: use ONLY its attractive rendered miniature-office/chibi-people style and coherent materials/lighting. NO interface text.
Canvas 1536x1024, EXACT regular grid of 3 columns by 2 rows, equal 512x512 cells, no grid lines. Every object entirely inside its cell with at least 24px clear padding. Genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside the objects. NO ground plane, NO colored background, NO checkerboard. Each cutout is one complete oak desktop workstation with gray metal legs, white padded low-back ergonomic swivel chair, laptop plus one monitor with blue-white abstract software UI (no readable text), 2-3 books, pencil cup, small green potted plant. One adorable 3D chibi adult employee sits correctly on the chair with both hands resting on keyboard on the tabletop, anatomically coherent contact. Show whole table legs, chair wheels and the employee's feet. Polished miniature 3D render, soft upper-left daylight. Fixed orthographic 2:1 dimetric view, all six desks EXACTLY same camera orientation/scale, viewed from behind and to the left of the seated employee, desktop screen visible over shoulder, no perspective size differences. All cutouts grounded at same relative bottom baseline, desk width around 450 px within each cell.
Cell order left to right top to bottom:
1. short tousled black-haired man with black glasses, dark navy cardigan and white shirt.
2. long chestnut-haired woman, cream blouse, muted brown trousers.
3. wavy brown-haired man, rust overshirt, no hat.
4. short dark-haired man, slate blue sweater.
5. shoulder-length auburn-haired woman, sage green cardigan.
6. same workstation and chair but EMPTY, no person.
Each unit contains only ONE person (except empty #6). Consistent cute large head but adult workers, no armor, weapons or fantasy outfits. Do not overlap neighboring cells. No labels, names, logos, cards, bubbles, text, arrows, room background or extra loose objects. Designed to slice deterministically into six equal cells.

Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: one transparent freestanding whiteboard sprite for an interactive 2.5D office.
Use supplied image only as reference for the polished miniature 3D material style and sunny upper-left light. Generate ONE large elegant mobile whiteboard, complete white writing surface, thin white and brushed-silver frame, two gray legs and four small caster wheels, narrow pen tray with three tiny colorful markers. Isolated real transparent alpha background, no floor plane or background. Landscape image 1024x768.
The board faces almost square toward the viewer, only a subtle 6 degree yaw so the right edge looks slightly smaller. Vertical sides vertical, top and bottom writing-surface edges almost horizontal. Writing surface is a broad 1.7:1 rectangle occupying roughly x 8%-92%, y 9%-68% of the canvas. Stand and wheels extend to y 94%, leave 4% clear padding. Board is slightly elevated-view compatible with an orthographic room camera at 30 degrees, but rotate its face toward the camera for reading dynamic content.
NO text, NO scribbles, NO stickers, NO UI, NO sticky notes, NO people or plants, NO logo. The writing surface must be perfectly clean white, solid opaque, softly lit. This will carry a separate dynamic web UI layer; preserve a generous clean white writing area. High quality rounded product render, soft natural contact shadow only directly under caster wheels, transparent otherwise.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2x2 directional sprite sheet, one friendly office assistant robot in four views.
Reference image: match the small white-and-blue assistant robot's polished miniature 3D feel, but create an original simple rounded helper. White ceramic shell, dark blue glossy face visor with two bright cyan eyes, small compact torso, rounded hands, short feet, no antennas or weapons. Consistent orthographic view elevated 30 degrees. Canvas 1024x1024 divided into EXACT four equal 512x512 cells. Each full robot about 300px tall with identical scale and foot baseline y=440 within its cell. Genuine transparent alpha, no floor plane, no colored haze, no environment. Very small soft shadow directly under feet only.
Top-left: front-left three-quarter view. Top-right: front-right three-quarter view. Bottom-left: back-left three-quarter view. Bottom-right: back-right three-quarter view. All show the SAME robot with SAME proportions and design, relaxed arms and feet, suitable for a gentle hovering motion. Whole robot fully contained in each cell with generous clear padding. No text, no labels, no grid lines, no UI or other objects. Sharp high quality natural upper-left daylight, soft highlights, cute understated expression.

Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the attached whiteboard image. Clean production game sprite. Keep the exact original whiteboard silhouette, dimensions, position, lighting, silver frame, slight perspective, blank white face, wheels and support legs. Remove ALL stray white speckles, fragmented white patches, blue fringe and cutout halos outside the physical board, especially above the top horizontal frame and below the bottom frame. Outside the actual object must be genuinely fully transparent, no background, no backdrop, no artificial cast shadow floating in space. Do not add content or text. Do not change the geometry. Return the same 4:3 composition with the complete board and its wheels.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original game UI portrait sprite sheet for this office, derived from the five employees in the reference sheet. Make a 3 columns by 2 rows regular grid, each cell exactly square with equal margins. Each cell contains one FRONT FACING head-and-shoulders chibi portrait centered, no desks, no chairs, no props, no circular frame, no lettering, no captions. Keep visual rendering style from reference: polished soft 3D clay-toy illustration, cute adult office workers, professional casual outfits, consistent natural warm sunlight. Grid order matching original: top left short black tousled hair, black rectangular glasses, navy sweater man; top middle long chestnut hair, cream blouse woman; top right wavy brown hair, rust colored sweater man; bottom left short dark hair, slate-blue sweater man without glasses; bottom middle shoulder-length auburn hair, sage cardigan woman; bottom right leave entirely transparent. All five look towards camera, smiling gently. Genuine transparent background around heads and shoulders; no scenery, no fake checkerboard. 1536x1024 sheet, six 512x512 cells.
